signal: first trading session each month at close; execute next trading session open
score: cached V1 ensemble cross-sectional ordinal rank
momentum: adjusted close(T)/adjusted close(T-60 sessions)-1 ordinal rank
primary_rule: equal weight of score and 60-session momentum ranks; Top2, equal weight
execution: same audited cash ledger; 100-share lots, capacity, limit locks, fees and slippage
